sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored Local: GGUF Quants + llama.cpp
sources.snippet: To run Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored locally, pull the gated GGUF repo orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF from Hugging Face, pick a quant by your VRAM — Q4_K_M (16.8 GB) for a 24 GB GPU, IQ4_XS (15.3 GB) for a 16 GB GPU, Q3_K_M (13.5 GB) when you want context headroom — and serve it with a current llama.cpp build using the --jinja flag, adding --mmproj if you need vision. sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored GGUF: Abliterated Local Build
sources.snippet: It is the same refusal-removed 27-billion-parameter weights as Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8, converted to GGUF for local inference: F16 plus 12 quantization tiers from Q2_K to Q8_0 (including the imatrix quants IQ3_M and IQ4_XS), the 262K context window, a separate vision projector, and the MTP speculative-decoding head intact.
